name: Bad Sisters
description: The tight-knit Garvey sisters have always looked out for one another. But when the toxic brother-in-law they all wanted dead actually dies, it turns their lives upside down and tests their bond like nothing before.

videos.title: The Prick
videos.overview: John Paul is dead. The Garvey sisters think it's all behind them—but the insurance men have questions.

videos.title: Explode a Man
videos.overview: As Thomas and Matt grasp at straws in the present, a sinister plot takes shape in the past.

videos.title: Chopped Liver
videos.overview: Ursula is next in John Paul's crosshairs. Thomas hopes the police will help him.

videos.title: Baby Becka
videos.overview: Becka comes to regret trusting John Paul. In the present, she and Matt get a shock.

videos.title: Eye for an Eye
videos.overview: Bibi is gripped by a bold, dangerous idea for John Paul's birthday. Matt learns a difficult truth.

videos.title: Splash
videos.overview: The Garvey sisters regroup as their fears grow for Grace's well-being. Thomas finally gets a lead.

videos.title: Rest in Peace
videos.overview: John Paul suspects foul play as he pieces together what happened. Thomas and Matt reconnect.

videos.title: The Cold Truth
videos.overview: Becka is determined to prove Eva wrong. Thomas and Matt wait for news of a breakthrough.

videos.title: Going Rogue
videos.overview: The sisters get a heartbreaking reality check. Matt steps up as Thomas begins to crumble.

videos.title: Saving Grace
videos.overview: Tensions run high as shocking revelations come to light. Time is running out for the Garvey sisters.

videos.title: Good Sisters
videos.overview: Two years after J.P.'s death, the Garvey sisters are moving on and finding new happiness—until a grisly discovery puts them back under suspicion.

videos.title: Penance
videos.overview: As Detectives Loftus and Houlihan investigate, Grace's behavior becomes increasingly erratic. Roger's sister, Angelica, stirs tensions.

videos.title: Missing
videos.overview: A devastating event leaves the sisters reeling. Loftus and Houlihan's search takes a turn. Ursula hits a breaking point.

videos.title: Person of Interest
videos.overview: Convinced that a blackmailer is to blame for their tragedy, the sisters look for evidence. Becka is shaken by life-changing news.

videos.title: Boom
videos.overview: In a bid to stay out of trouble, the sisters take the next step in their plan with Angelica—just as a desperate Eva puts a target on their backs.

videos.title: Who by Water
videos.overview: Ian helps the sisters cover their tracks, bringing him closer to Eva but further into Houlihan's spotlight.

videos.title: How to Pick a Prick
videos.overview: The sisters hunt for the truth after a shocking betrayal while Houlihan goes head-to-head with Loftus.

videos.title: Cliff Hanger
videos.overview: As Houlihan discovers shocking revelations, the sisters face an impossible situation.

country: United States, Belgium, United Kingdom, Ireland
awards: Nominated for 5 Primetime Emmys. 19 wins & 51 nominations total
